pages.title: Products
pages.content:
Products

Four families of passive parts: multilayer ceramic capacitors, chip resistors, power inductors and ferrite beads. The full range with sizes, values and ratings follows in the next release of this site.

See the sample kits

pages.title: Quality
pages.content:
Quality

Every lot is measured and the figures are published each month: 0.6 ppm outgoing defect rate over the last twelve months and 97.8% on-time delivery against the first confirmed date.

Request samples

pages.title: Plant
pages.content:
Plant

Eindhoven, three shifts, powder to taped reel. A continuous kiln at 1,250 °C and a reel store that holds 41,000 reels.

Request samples

pages.title: Cases
pages.content:
Cases

Three recent customer projects, described with the results the customers measured themselves: a hearing device, an e-bike motor controller and a smart electricity meter.

Request samples

pages.title: About
pages.content:
About

Denki Components B.V. began in 1987 with fourteen people and one line of disc capacitors. Today 420 colleagues make four families of passive parts, with 1,240 part numbers in the catalogue.

Request samples

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Contact

Kanaalweg Oost 18, 5644 RK Eindhoven, Netherlands. Office Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:30 CET. Write to samples@denki-components.example or call +31 40 000 1987; the sample desk answers within 1 working day.

Request samples

pages.title: Samples
pages.content:
Samples

Capacitor kit 0402 €65, resistor kit 0402 €48, power inductor kit €72, ferrite bead kit €39. Up to 5 part numbers × 50 pieces are free for qualified projects. Kit shipping €12 within the EU, €28 elsewhere.

Contact the sample desk

pages.title: Ceramic capacitors
pages.content:
Ceramic capacitors

Multilayer chips from C0G for timing and filters to X7R and X5R for decoupling, plus an automotive series qualified to AEC-Q200. 0201–1210 · 0.5 pF–100 µF · 6.3–100 V.

See the sample kits

pages.title: Chip resistors
pages.content:
Chip resistors

Thick-film and precision resistors with an anti-sulfur series for boards near rubber, oil and exhaust gas. 0201–2512 · 1 Ω–10 MΩ · 0.1–5 %.

See the sample kits

pages.title: Inductors & ferrite beads
pages.content:
Inductors & ferrite beads

Shielded power inductors for DC-DC converters and chip beads for noise suppression. Inductors 2016–6060 · 0.24–47 µH · 1–18 A; beads 0402–1206 · 10 Ω–2.2 kΩ at 100 MHz.

See the sample kits
